title: Verbs of motion
description: Iść and chodzić on foot, jechać and jeździć by vehicle, in the present tense.

sections.text: Iść and jechać describe one trip in one direction, often happening now. Chodzić and jeździć describe habits, repeated trips or round trips. Iść and chodzić are on foot; jechać and jeździć are by vehicle.

examples.translation: I am walking to the shop now.
On Saturdays I go to the pool.
Tomorrow I am going to Kraków.
